arithmetic_certificate.rounding: Every operation rounded outward to integer multiples of the common denominator.
arithmetic_certificate.inverse_sqrt: Integer isqrt with exact lower-square and upper-square comparisons.
arithmetic_certificate.logarithm: Binary range reduction; 2*atanh(t) positive series with 0<=t<=1/3 and exact tail upper bound <=1/denominator.
arithmetic_certificate.waveform: On each integer-delimited segment, 2*(A-D*x^(-1/2)); exact integer signed coefficients.
arithmetic_certificate.energy_identity: P_energy = G_energy + H_energy + C, where C=2*integral(G*H).

scope: Actual finite Mobius prime-shell software interval diagnostics. No Lean certificate, all-T bound, reserve construction, P04 proof or RH proof is asserted.
coefficient_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of canonical compact JSON integer arrays indexed by n=1..N; omitted-term records use sorted JSON object keys.
